name: Amit Kumar Das
bio: Dr Amit Kumar Das has worked in data science in industry and in academic research and teaching for more than 28 years. He is also Professor and Dean, Industry Consultancy, at the Institute of Engineering & Management, and was previously a Principal Director at LTIMindtree. He holds a PhD in machine learning from the University of Calcutta, has written data science and AI textbooks published by Pearson, and is a Senior Member of IEEE.

name: Abhijit Pal
role: Director and Chief of Strategy, Growth and Innovation
bio: Abhijit Pal has about 27 years of experience in technology consulting, covering IT and digital strategy, implementation and value realisation for clients in India and abroad, across government, retail, healthcare, education, telecommunications and manufacturing. He now leads strategy at an Indian data, analytics and AI company, mentors startups and students, and is an honorary adviser to the IT Committee of the Bengal Chamber of Commerce and Industry. He graduated in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering from Jadavpur University.

name: Deb Kumar Majumder
bio: Deb Kumar Majumder is a business and technology transformation leader with more than 30 years at PwC and IBM in management consulting, technology leadership and global delivery. At IBM he led service lines in cybersecurity, data and technology, and HR and talent transformation, each spread across several countries. He speaks often on data and AI, cybersecurity and the future of work, and is a member of the IT Committee of the Bengal Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

name: Sudip Dasgupta
bio: Sudip Dasgupta is an enterprise technology leader and generative and agentic AI architect with more than 26 years of experience, much of it leading large technology programmes for Fortune 500 organisations. At Cognizant he leads enterprise AI work focused on agentic AI, cognitive platforms and responsible AI adoption: taking AI from experiments to systems that are secure, governed and useful. He holds AI-related patents and has published research and books.
